chose: read the git queue key from the filesystem (.git, gitdir:, commondir), one shared in-flight read per path never abandoned and never replaced by a fallback key; admitted calls race it against their admission deadline
over: a git rev-parse key (a hung rev-parse stalled every repository, a failed one split a repository across queues); a 20 s key-read timeout with a fallback key (leaks a threadpool worker per timeout and splits the queue)
because: no repository may ever run in two queues; the open trade-off is that a plain call on a stalled mount waits until it answers, as does a serial caller looping over repositories (server/github/issues-wiring.ts), and each distinct stalled path parks one libuv worker
binding: none: this session owns no active work order
